scope.inspection_method: The author actually opened every final full-page PNG with the image-viewing tool and visually read it after the last build and render. A successful render alone was not treated as visual acceptance.

page_findings.observation: Opened the complete page image: the title and purpose precede the full theorem, the positive-definite hypothesis is legible, and the inverse change and completed square fit without clipping. Ordinary explanatory blocks are 2-3 normal lines; the canonical theorem remains unabridged. The page ends after naming the residual.

Opened the complete page image: both implications, the unique minimum, scalar positive example and negative-A boundary are legible. No orphaned mathematical symbol or overlapping display is present. The bibliography uses a short linked label and stays inside the text block; its actual PDF URI was separately checked.

scope.rhythm_policy: RHY targets about 2-3 ordinary normal typeset lines. Full canonical statements and exact imported interfaces are retained; specific longer-block reasons are in the corresponding page observations. No forced prose line breaks, 2em layout override or shrunken math font.

findings: Every page listed in scope was opened and visually inspected in full against these exact final rendered images. No clipping, overlapping display, missing formula glyph, unresolved reference or unreadable bibliography was observed.
The page observations record concrete layout checks and the actual rhythm exceptions. Text extraction and successful build logs were supplementary checks only.

unchecked_items.reason: No independent visual reviewer or print-production proof is claimed; screen image inspection was performed by the author.

reviewer: Local mathematical author, actual AI image inspection; not an independent visual reviewer
